exampleEn: Feel free to chime in if you have any suggestions during the meeting.
exampleKo: 회의 도중에 제안이 있으면 언제든지 끼어들어도 좋습니다.
gameExamples: I was listening to their discussion, and I decided to chime in with my thoughts.
Whenever the topic of travel comes up, Jane loves to chime in with her experiences.
It's important to let everyone have a chance to chime in during group projects.
